title: xxxomer12345678 Executor V1
script:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- GUI OLUŞTUR
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
gui.Name = "UltraRainbowExecutor"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- RESİM (Ortada başlar, sola kayar)
local resim = Instance.new("ImageLabel", gui)
resim.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
resim.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.5, -50)
resim.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
resim.Image = "rbxassetid://87037524224966"
resim.BackgroundTransparency = 1

-- RESMİ DÖNDÜR
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		resim.Rotation += 1
		task.wait()
	end
end)

-- GUI FRAME (başta ekranda değil, sağda bekler)
local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 300)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

-- KENARLAR - BEYAZ ÇUBUK
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
stroke.Thickness = 3
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local uicorner = Instance.new("UICorner", frame)
uicorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- RAINBOW ANİMASYON
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		for h = 0, 1, 0.01 do
			local color = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
			stroke.Color = color
			task.wait(0.02)
		end
	end
end)

-- ANİMASYON: RESİM sola gider, GUI sağdan gelir
TweenService:Create(resim, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
	Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.5, -50)
}):Play()

TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.3, 0)
}):Play()

-- EXECUTOR TEXTBOX
local textbox = Instance.new("TextBox", frame)
textbox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.5, 0)
textbox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.05, 0)
textbox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
textbox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
textbox.PlaceholderText = "-- Buraya Script Yaz --"
textbox.Text = ""
textbox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
textbox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
textbox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
textbox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
textbox.TextWrapped = true
textbox.TextScaled = false
textbox.MultiLine = true

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", textbox)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- ÇALIŞTIR BUTONU
local run = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
run.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40)
run.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.65, 0)
run.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
run.Text = "🚀 ÇALIŞTIR"
run.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
run.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
run.TextScaled = true
Instance.new("UICorner", run).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- TEMİZLE BUTONU
local clear = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
clear.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40)
clear.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.65, 0)
clear.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
clear.Text = "🧹 TEMİZLE"
clear.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
clear.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
clear.TextScaled = true
Instance.new("UICorner", clear).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- BUTON FONKSİYONLARI
run.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local source = textbox.Text
	local func = loadstring(source)
	if func then
		pcall(func)
	end
end)

clear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	textbox.Text = ""
end)-- Scroll Menü Sol Tarafa
local menuFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", frame)
menuFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0)
menuFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, -130, 0, 0)
menuFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 10, 0) -- sonsuz gibi
menuFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
menuFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
menuFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
menuFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
menuFrame.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
Instance.new("UICorner", menuFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- UIList düzeni
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", menuFrame)
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

local function createMegaButton(text, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", menuFrame)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 40)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 234, 0)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	return btn
end

-- 1. HACK GAME 101
createMegaButton("🔥 Hack Game 101", function()
	for _, m in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if m:IsA("Model") then
			m:PivotTo(m:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
		end
	end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local oldPos = cam.CFrame
	local zoom = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
	zoom.Size = Vector3.new(10,1,10)
	zoom.Position = Vector3.new(0,100,0)
	zoom.Anchored = true
	zoom.BrickColor = BrickColor.Red()

	local decal = Instance.new("Decal", zoom)
	decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://87037524224966"
	decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top

	workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 120, 0)

	task.delay(1, function()
		local spinningWorld = workspace:GetChildren()
		for _, obj in pairs(spinningWorld) do
			if obj:IsA("Model") then
				task.spawn(function()
					while true do
						obj:PivotTo(obj:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0.1, 0.1, 0.1))
						task.wait()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)
end)

-- 2. REMOTE FIRE
createMegaButton("🛰️ Remote Fire", function()
	for _, r in pairs(getgc(true)) do
		if typeof(r) == "function" and getfenv(r).script then
			pcall(function()
				r()
			end)
		end
	end
end)

-- 3. GOKU BUTONU
createMegaButton("💥 GOKU", function()
	local gokuGui = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
	gokuGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 250)
	gokuGui.Position = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0.3, 0)
	gokuGui.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
	Instance.new("UICorner", gokuGui).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", gokuGui)
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

	local function gokuButton(text, callback)
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", gokuGui)
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
		btn.Text = text
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 222, 0)
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextScaled = true
		Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
	end

	-- SÜPER GÜÇ AL
	gokuButton("⚡ SÜPER GÜÇ AL", function()
		local chr = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if chr then
			local fx = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", chr.HumanoidRootPart)
			fx.Texture = "rbxassetid://4834067840"
			fx.Speed = NumberRange.new(10)
			fx.Rate = 1000
			fx.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2)
			task.delay(4, function()
				fx:Destroy()
			end)
			for i = 1, 10 do
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0.01, 0, 0)
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- YIKIM
	gokuButton("💀 YIKIM", function()
		local chr = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if not chr then return end
		local target = nil
		for _, p in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and p.Character then
				if (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - chr.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude < 15 then
					target = p.Character
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if target then
			local pos = target.HumanoidRootPart.Position
			for i = 1, 30 do
				chr:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(i)*5, 2, math.cos(i)*5)))
				task.wait(0.02)
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
			chr:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(target.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,2,0))

			local blood = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
			blood.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
			blood.Position = target.HumanoidRootPart.Position
			blood.BrickColor = BrickColor.Red()
			blood.Anchored = true
			blood.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

			game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(blood, 3)

			pcall(function()
				target.Humanoid.Health -= 50
			end)
		end
	end)
end)createMegaButton("🔥 SERVER FİXXED", function()
	for _, d in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
			pcall(function()
				d.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
				if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
					d.Text = "XXXHUB FİXXED THE GAMEE EZZZZ N1K1R BY XXXHUB"
					d.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 1, 1)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	for _, m in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if m:IsA("Model") then
			local p = Instance.new("Part", m)
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
			p.Position = m:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
			local fire = Instance.new("Fire", p)
			fire.Heat = 25
			fire.Size = 20
			p.Name = "🔥666🔥"
		end
	end

	-- BLOK YAĞMURU
	for i = 1, 100 do
		local b = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
		b.Size = Vector3.new(3,3,3)
		b.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-200,200), 100 + i * 2, math.random(-200,200))
		b.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
		b.Anchored = false
		b.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(0.03)
	end
end)createMegaButton("🫀 KALP ÇIKARTMA", function()
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool", game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
	tool.Name = "Kalp Çıkarıcı"
	tool.RequiresHandle = false

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local chr = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local mouse = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
		local target = mouse.Target

		if target and target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			local victim = target.Parent

			-- TP + Freeze
			chr:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(victim.PrimaryPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2))
			victim.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true

			-- Kalp çıkartma efekti
			local kan = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", victim.Head)
			kan.Texture = "rbxassetid://4834067840"
			kan.Speed = NumberRange.new(5)
			kan.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1)
			kan.Rate = 300
			kan.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
			task.delay(3, function()
				kan:Destroy()
			end)

			-- El kalbe girsin
			local el = Instance.new("Part", chr)
			el.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
			el.Position = chr.HumanoidRootPart.Position
			el.Anchored = true
			el.BrickColor = BrickColor.Red()
			el.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			task.wait(0.5)

			local heartTool = Instance.new("Tool", game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
			heartTool.Name = "❤️ Kalp"
			local handle = Instance.new("Part", heartTool)
			handle.Name = "Handle"
			handle.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
			handle.BrickColor = BrickColor.Red()
			handle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

			-- Oyuncu ölür
			pcall(function()
				victim.Humanoid.Health = 0
			end)
		end
	end)
end)
